description: This file contains unit tests for the QpackDecodedHeadersAccumulator class in the QUIC protocol implementation, testing header decoding, error handling, and dynamic table interactions.

classes.name: MockVisitor
classes.description: Mock class implementing QpackDecodedHeadersAccumulator::Visitor for testing callback invocations.

classes.name: QpackDecodedHeadersAccumulatorTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing QpackDecodedHeadersAccumulator behavior.

methods.name: EmptyPayload
methods.description: Test that an empty payload triggers a header decoding error for incomplete header data prefix.

methods.name: TruncatedHeaderBlockPrefix
methods.description: Test that a truncated header block prefix results in a decoding error.

methods.name: EmptyHeaderList
methods.description: Test decoding of an empty header list.

methods.name: TruncatedPayload
methods.description: Test that an incomplete payload triggers a header decoding error for incomplete header block.

methods.name: InvalidPayload
methods.description: Test that referencing a non-existing static table entry results in a decoding error.

methods.name: Success
methods.description: Test successful decoding of a header block with specific headers.

methods.name: ExceedLimitThenSplitInstruction
methods.description: Test behavior when header list size exceeds limit and header instructions are split.

methods.name: ExceedLimitBlocked
methods.description: Test header limit enforcement with blocked dynamic table entries.

methods.name: BlockedDecoding
methods.description: Test decoding when dynamic table entries are not yet received, causing blocking.

methods.name: BlockedDecodingUnblockedBeforeEndOfHeaderBlock
methods.description: Test unblocking of decoding before end of header block after dynamic table update.

methods.name: BlockedDecodingUnblockedAndErrorBeforeEndOfHeaderBlock
methods.description: Regression test for error handling when dynamic table index is invalid during blocking.
